entries.summary: Mirage shape projection supports solid/linear/radial paints and image brushes; graphics PatternPaint/ImagePaint remain deterministic unsupported diagnostics in this wave.
Shape path serialization uses flattened PathF projection for deterministic browser SVG output, which may approximate native arc curve fidelity in edge cases.
Path render-transform projection currently supports TranslateTransform. Other MAUI transform types are handled as deterministic unsupported fallbacks.
